review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C bundle. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, task keys, repository identity and base commit agree with the original PRD. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; only that branch is required. This does not waive the decisions-stage block for a material unresolved DEC-001 in B. The exact writable scope covers the maintained implementation, declarations and regression files without requiring gratuitous edits; package.json supports the stated xo/ava/tsd verification entry point. The two task roles and verification dependency match the specification. Their allowed agents have the relevant supplied active trusted capability claims and availability, including data.change, domain.state and integration.consumer; pending security.authorization claims are not needed for this bounded requirement. A separate active, non-autoassignable reviewer supports the independent-review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct source-manifest, evaluation-source and normalized-PRD digest domains. The original specification's preparation placeholders are distinguishable from the later frozen preview. The truncated test excerpts do not prevent assessing the declared ownership and planning expectations; this approval does not attest to complete test coverage or execution. No candidate outputs were used, no code was executed, no new human attestation was made, and all digest checks are accepted as Service-provided mechanical bindings rather than independently recomputed hashes.
